objective: Complete every exact gap that the VLM explicitly assessed as ground in the same review round, reducing redundant Agent observations without broadening semantic authority.

safety_contract.semantic_authority: Only an explicit ground assessment from the current VLM response is eligible.
safety_contract.geometry_authority: A deterministic bounding rectangle addresses the gap, then apply_operations intersects it with the exact current hole_id raster mask before any pixel is added.
never_synthesized: omitted assessments conservatively repaired as non_ground
gaps when the feature is explicitly disabled
safety_contract.candidate_boundary: The result remains a machine candidate and follows the existing convergence or human-review gate.

archived_frame_33_replay.hard_result: Two GPT review calls were eliminated while preserving the archived final geometry and human-review boundary.
archived_frame_33_replay.timing_boundary: The first candidate call was an exact-cache hit, so elapsed time is not a cold matched A/B.

fresh_frame_29_same_input_ab.hard_result: One GPT review call was eliminated on a second real frame with identical final geometry and the same done outcome.
fresh_frame_29_same_input_ab.timing_boundary: The candidate ran second and its first call hit the exact cache; call reduction and geometry equality are stronger evidence than elapsed-time reduction.

fresh_frame_34_neutral_ab.result: The feature was neutral when no explicit unfilled ground gap was available.

failed_closed_reconstruction.result: Fresh SAM drafts did not match the archived initial fingerprints, so historical replay stopped before any GPT request and was not reported as an A/B.

bounded_archive_scan.boundary: This is a read-only structural scan of archived decisions, not a replay of image semantics.

regression.collection_boundary: A repository-root pytest invocation incorrectly collected an optional SAM3 qualitative example and stopped because matplotlib was absent; the project test scope is tests/, which passed in full without installing unrelated dependencies.

deployment.lifecycle: Only the managed local workbench process was restarted; the 4090 model tunnel and remote SAM/VLM processes remained hot.

boundaries: No SAM or VLM weight was changed.
